name: dev.ucp.shopping.fulfillment.carrier_pickup
title: Carrier Pickup Extension
description: Defines the `carrier_pickup` fulfillment method: the Business ships to a parcel locker or staffed pickup point operated by a carrier network, and the Buyer collects the parcel there. Requires the Fulfillment extension.

network_offer.title: Carrier Network Offer
network_offer.description: A carrier network the Business ships to through this method.

network.description: Carrier network identifier, matching `network` on Carrier Point Destinations.

name.description: Buyer-facing name of the network or of the service the Business sells on it.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries where the Business ships to this network's points. Absent means not stated.

point_types.description: Point types the Business accepts on this network, using the `point_type` values of Carrier Point Destinations. Absent means all.

buyer_field_requirement.title: Buyer Field Requirement
buyer_field_requirement.description: A Buyer field the method needs, and why.

field.description: Name of the field on Checkout `buyer`. Well-known values: `phone_number`, `email`, `first_name`, `last_name`.

purpose.description: Why the method needs the field. Well-known values: `pickup_notification` (the network sends the deposit notice or the collection code to it; a `phone_number` for this purpose must receive text messages), `recipient_identification` (staff check the recipient's name at handover). Businesses MAY use additional values.

networks.description: Networks that need the field. Absent means every network of the method.

carrier_pickup_method.title: Fulfillment Method (Carrier Pickup)
carrier_pickup_method.description: Contract for a Fulfillment Method whose `type` is `carrier_pickup`. Methods of other types are unchanged.

destinations.description: Carrier points for this method. The Platform MAY write a point the Buyer chose by its point key; the Business returns resolved points, and MAY list nearby points it suggests.

networks.description: Carrier networks the Business accepts for this method's line items.

required_buyer_fields.description: Buyer fields the method needs to create the shipment. The Business lists only fields the method needs; Platforms collect and send these, and need not send other Buyer fields for this method.

dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.title: Checkout with Carrier Pickup
dev.ucp.shopping.checkout.description: Checkout whose fulfillment methods may use the `carrier_pickup` type.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Carrier Pickup
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order whose fulfillment events may report deposit at, collection from, and expiry at a carrier point.

networks.description: Carrier networks the Business ships to, so a Platform can offer the right point selector before Checkout.
